svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P10 · THE CHARGE PATH, THE UPRIGHT B MODULE, AND THE SIDE RAIL
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P10 · UNIVERSAL Qİ2 CHARGING, 90°-BENT-STEM B & ONLY USB-C IN B
Portless 4-Quadrant (+) body charges on any Qi/Qi2.2 wireless pad (15-25 W). ONLY the B stem is bent at 90° (holding the ONLY USB-C port); the round ring sits flat ON TOP OF the screen.
A · PORTLESS Qİ / Qİ2.2 WIRELESS BODY & ZERO USB-C ON THE SCREEN BODY

g.text: there is NO USB Type-C port and NO physical button anywhere on the 4-piece screen body
central Ø54.0 mm 4-sector Qi2.2 MPP receiver coil (90 deg sector in each quadrant Q1..Q4)
4 x Ø22.0 mm standalone per-quadrant Qi sub-coils + nanocrystalline magnetic shielding
the assembled phone charges at 15-25 W on any standard Qi / Qi2 / MagSafe wireless pad
any single detached quadrant tile also charges independently at 5-10 W on any wireless pad
bulky external bottom battery pack is eliminated: batteries live inside the 4 polycarbonate tiles
4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh (3 200 mAh) non-flammable LLZO/PEO all-solid-state battery (0% liquid, 0 HF)
Rule Q-1 (Rev L.5.0): the screen body charges ONLY wirelessly; wired USB-C is ONLY on the B module
without the B camera module, the screen body can only charge wirelessly on a pad
all other functions (wired USB-C, Zero-CPU UWB/mmWave, TCON, camera, audio) require the B module
each quadrant tile swaps by hand in under 3 s across the (+) cross (EU 2023/1542 Article 11)
<15 um n=1.585 self-healing optical seam lip ensures zero scratch and zero visible seam line

svg.text: B · THE CHARGE PATHS (REV L.5.0) · Universal Qi2 Wireless + B-Module USB-C

g.text: THE PATH
THE POWER
ARCHITECTURE
Qi2.2 MPP wireless on 4-tile body
15 - 25 W wireless
Ø54 mm 4-sector coil around (0,0)
Qi wireless on single detached tile
5 - 10 W wireless
Ø22 mm local coil + U_QI PMIC
ONLY USB-C in 90°-Bent B Stem
routes power via 12 surface pads
(+) Cross 64 gold micro-leaves
40 W inter-tile bus
12 mΩ parallel + 3 ms Dead-Pad
16 gold micro-leaf contacts per internal (+) edge (64 total) + central Titanium Cruciform Hub
6 bipolar N52H magnets + 2 tapered Ti micro-dovetail pins per edge (<2.5 um Z-step)
contacts are recessed inside the 12 um n=1.585 optical lip and dead until 3 ms ECDSA handshake
when 1 quadrant is pulled for hot-swap, the other 3 quadrants (9.0 Wh) sustain the session
hardware NTC thermal limiter caps ocular surface temperature at <=36.2 °C in eyewear mode
bifilar current-canceling tabs + Mu-metal foil keep ELF magnetic field below 0.08 µT
antenna isolated in the 90° B stem away from the eye keeps Head/Eye SAR at 0.054 W/kg
10 000 mate cycles across the (+) cross and the B module surface dock (IP68 sealed)

svg.text: C · THE 90°-BENT-STEM B MODULE (ONLY STEM ABOVE EDGE, RING ON SCREEN)

g.text: ONLY the straight antenna stem (cubuk, 6.4 x 44.0 mm) is bent at a 90-degree right angle
only the 90°-bent stem stays up/on the edge while the round ring (32 x 32 x 4.00 mm) lies ON screen
+/-90° reversible Grade-5 Titanium neck hinge lets the B module attach to FRONT or BACK of screen
docks along all 4 orientations (Top, Bottom, Left, Right edges) with r = 0.55 mm softened edges
the 90°-bent stem houses the 3-band LCP antenna (Wi-Fi 7, BT 5.4, UWB) + 1x4 60 GHz patch array
the 90°-bent stem also houses the device's ONLY USB Type-C (40W PD 3.1 + DP 2.1, IP68) port
the circular ring (Ø32.0 mm outer / Ø24.0 mm inner bore) sits flat on the polycarbonate screen
front of ring bore holds the 50 MP OIS CMOS sensor, folded prism, 5P lens, 2 mics, speaker, flash
back of ring bore holds the Ø22.4 mm round LTPO AMOLED (220 x 220 px, 1-120 Hz) + Cu-Graphite shield
6-layer annular Zero-CPU PCBA holds U1 Quad-Tile Master TCON + U2 UWB/60GHz SiP + U3 Audio DSP
symmetric bipolar N52H magnet ring + 12 gold pogo/optical surface pads + IP68 FKM gasket
retention: 8.5 N normal pull, 10 000 cycles, IP68 sealed (1.5 m, 30 min)
mass: 22.0 g (4-Quadrant (+) body is 72.0 g = 4 x 18 g; complete device is 94.0 g, 84 internal parts)
camera barrel does not internally rotate; instead the whole B module attaches to Front or Back

svg.text: D · 4-QUADRANT (+) SOLID-STATE BATTERY TILES & EYEWEAR BIOCOMPATIBILITY

g.text: each 40.0 x 80.0 x 2.20 mm polycarbonate tile (Q1..Q4, 18.0 g) encapsulates a 3.0 Wh LLZO cell
non-flammable oxide-ceramic/PEO electrolyte: 0% liquid solvent, 0% LiPF6, 0.0 ppm HF gas, 0% swelling
safe for direct eye proximity in glasses/visor mode (<=36.2 C, ELF <0.08 uT, SAR 0.054 W/kg)

90°-Bent-Stem B module (22.0 g) carries the device's ONLY USB Type-C (40W PD 3.1 + DP 2.1, IP68)
also carries U1 Quad-Tile Master TCON, U2 UWB/60GHz mmWave SiP, U3 Audio DSP, and 50 MP OIS camera
satisfies EU Common Charger Directive 2022/2380 and EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 Article 11
when B is detached, the 4-quadrant screen body is 100% portless/buttonless and charges on any Qi2 pad

svg.text: E · WHY NOT BEHIND THE SCREEN · the refused reading, with numbers

g.text: a flexible OLED passes 2.9 percent of the light at the camera area, with haze and a yellow shift
a transparent OLED passes about 20 percent, and its pixel grid blurs along one axis
the industry ships a 4 MP class under-display camera, and states a 30 percent degradation
the pixel opening cuts whole spatial frequencies, and computation cannot bring them back
the upright B module carries a 1-inch-class 50 MP / 12.5 MP sensor with an unobstructed lens
the panel bends over its whole area to R 25.5 mm, and a reduced-stack window is a stress riser
the top-edge B module gives a real lens in front and a Ø22.4 mm round AMOLED viewfinder in back
the review trigger: a 20 MP class at 70 percent transmission on a flexible panel. no date
the refusal stands until that part exists, and Part 19, Section 19.3 keeps the row

svg.text: F · THE TRIAL · fourteen tests, thirty coupons, one fixture

g.text: 1 top-edge retention (25 N) · 2 shear and peel · 3 1 000 attach cycles · 4 drop fitted (1.2 m)
5 contact wear at 20 000 and 50 000 mates · 6 4-layer battery bend at R 25.5 mm (0.38% strain)
7 magnetic field and touch map · 8 top-edge seat identity handshake in 1 000 trials (3 ms)
9 100% open 11 947 mm² screen + Ø22.4 mm rear round AMOLED · 10 viewfinder latency (<16 ms)
11 thermal rise fitted (<43 °C) · 12 IP68 seal in five states · 13 wall/desk hold · 14 ergonomics
the fixture: a two-axis pull rig with a top-edge seat fixture, built before the first coupon
MEC-6 and RF-3 test the 15-25 W Qi2.2 wireless body, the 40 W B-stem USB-C, and SAR 0.054 W/kg
decisions K1, B1, M1, M2, E1, Q1, S1 stand in Part 20, Section 20.6 (Revision L.5.0)
